headline: Welsh Actor Matthew Rhys Makes Emmy History with Unprecedented Double Win
meta_description: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys becomes first person ever to win two lead acting Emmys in one night, honoring Wales on stage.
summary_short: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys made Emmy Awards history by becoming the first person to win two lead acting prizes in a single night.
body:
Welsh actor Matthew Rhys has achieved what no one has done before: winning two lead acting Emmys in one evening. At the prestigious US ceremony, he claimed best lead actor in a limited series for The Beast In Me, then took best lead actor in a comedy for Widow's Bay. While actors including Alan Alda, Sally Field, and Elisabeth Moss have previously been nominated for two lead acting prizes in the same year, Rhys is the first to achieve a double victory. On stage, he dedicated his second award "to the great and good people of Wales," calling his small nation "a small but mighty nation," and spoke in Welsh, saying "Diolch yn fawr iawn." Backstage, he reflected on the significance: "I'm from a small country, and I'm glad we get moments to put our flag on the map and say, 'we punch higher than our weight sometimes'." The moment revealed something deeper than individual achievement—it was a proud assertion of Welsh identity on one of entertainment's largest stages.

Rhys credited his scene partner Claire Danes for bringing out his best work in The Beast In Me, the psychological thriller about a grieving author drawn into mystery. Later, accepting the comedy prize for playing the mayor in Widow's Bay, he thanked his parents for putting him on stage at an early age, acknowledging the long journey behind this culminating night.

His Widow's Bay co-star Kate O'Flynn, from Greater Manchester, also won best supporting comedy actress for playing Patricia in the show about a fictional island cursed for centuries. The night celebrated not only individual brilliance but the human connections—between scene partners, family, and country—that make excellence possible.
quick_facts: Matthew Rhys won two lead acting Emmys in one night—a first in Emmy history
He won for The Beast In Me and Widow's Bay, beating four other nominees
No actor had previously won two lead acting Emmys in the same evening
Rhys thanked Wales on stage and spoke Welsh, saying 'Diolch yn fawr iawn'
Co-star Kate O'Flynn from Greater Manchester also won for Widow's Bay
